AO No. 469 of 2012 
Hon’ble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.
Mr. M. K. Goyal, Advocate, present 
for the appellant. 
It is a belated appeal accompanied 
with an application under Section 5 of the 
Limitation act. 
Let notices may go to all the 
respondents on Section 5 application. 
List this matter after four weeks. 
(Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.) 
14.9.2012 
Kuldeep

AO No.469 of 2012 
Hon’ble B.S. Verma, J.
Heard Mr. M.K. Goyal, Advocate for the appellant 
and Ms. Arti, Advocate holding brief of Mr. Manish 
Arora, Advocate for the respondent. 
This is delay condonation application no.9806 of 
2013 for condoning the delay in filing the appeal. 
Cause shown is sufficient. The delay condonation 
application is allowed. Delay is condoned. Appeal is treated 
to be filed within time. 
Also heard on admission. 
Admit the appeal. 
Summon the lower court record. 
List after winter vacation.
Also heard on the stay application no.9807 of 2012. 
If the appellant deposits the entire awarded 
amount (minus statutory deposit) with the MACT 
concerned within a period of eight weeks, the execution 
of the impugned award shall remain stayed. (Stay 
Application is disposed of). 
 (B.S. Verma, J.) 
 04.01.2013
Rajni

07.05.2025 AO No.469 of 2012
Hon’ble J.C.S. Rawat, J. (Retd.)
Mahesh Chandra Pant, Adv./Member
None is present for the parties.
The order dated 19.02.2025 and the 
service report dated 18.02.2025 and 11.03.2025 
reveals that the respondent no. 5 and 6 has been 
served personally whereas the rest of the 
respondents are concerned that they are not 
residing at the given address and the address is 
not correct.
In view of the above, the appellant’s 
counsel was directed to take fresh steps in the 
Registry, but he has failed to take steps.
In the above circumstance, the matter be sent to 
the Hon’ble Court for final adjudication. The 
record be placed before the learned Registrar 
(Judicial) to list it before the Hon’ble Court as 
expeditiously as possible.
(Mahesh Ch. Pant,Adv./Member) (J.C.S.Rawat,J.(Retd.)
